A new signing key, which means this one does not install over 2.1.0. Read the next
paragraph before you download it.

## Uninstall first, and take your settings with you

Sanctumd is signed with a different key from here on. Android refuses to update an app
when the key changes, so 2.1.0 has to go before 2.1.1 can arrive. Your configuration
does not have to go with it:

1. In the app, open settings, then "backup / data", and export. You pick the password.
2. Uninstall Sanctumd.
3. Install the APK below.
4. Open settings, "backup / data", import, and give it that password.

Why the key changed: the password to the old one existed only inside the build secrets,
where nothing can read it back out. Had those been lost, the app could never have been
updated again and everyone would have had to reinstall anyway. The release had no
downloads yet, so this was the cheapest moment there will ever be.

## Four screens taken apart

Nothing here is visible. The four longest screens were split into files that each do one
thing, and the dialogs now hold and load their own state instead of being fed by the
screen behind them.

| screen   | before | after |
|----------|-------:|------:|
| Seerr    |    810 |   378 |
| \*arr    |    668 |   370 |
| Jellyfin |    585 |   433 |
| Prowlarr |    474 |   280 |

## Small print

- A tick, a star and a heart were sitting in labels as plain characters, where the font
  decides how they look and a screen reader reads them out. They come from the theme as
  icons now.
- Three German strings in the television client were translated.

## Installing

- Phone: `sanctumd-v2.1.1.apk`
- Android TV: `sanctumd-tv-v2.1.1.apk`

The television build installs beside the phone app, not over it. Both need the old
version removed first, for the reason above.
